text:
Type: upholstered dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: contemporary, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: woven textured fabric upholstery, dark stained wooden legs, chrome steel leg sleeves and stretchers
Colors: light beige-grey fabric, dark brown, silver chrome
Shape: tall straight upholstered back flowing into a padded seat, armless, four slim tapered legs with metal sleeves joined by chrome stretchers, slender and upright
Feel: soft, neat, understated, comfortable
Goes with: dark or light wood tables, grey or white walls, chrome accents; modern or Scandinavian dining rooms
